{{Current events|year=2019|month=11|day=2|content=
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A [[2019 Tell Abyad bombing|car bomb explodes]] in [[Tell Abyad]], [[Raqqa Governorate]], on the [[Syria-Turkey border|Turkish border]]. It kills 13 people and wounds more than 30 others, mostly civilians. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-blast/explosion-in-syrian-town-on-turkish-border-kills-10-media-observatory-idUSKBN1XC0BW?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**A [[bomb]] blast kills nine children, aged seven to ten, who were on their way to school in [[Takhar Province]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50275243 (BBC News)]
*[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]]
**Turkish [[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|Interior Minister]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] announces that ISIL prisoners will be [[deportation|sent back]] to their home countries. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-islamic-state/turkey-says-will-send-islamic-state-prisoners-to-home-countries-idUSKBN1XC08B?il=0 (Reuters)]
**ISIL claims responsibility for the attack in [[Mali]] on 1 November that killed 54. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/militants-kill-54-attack-mali-army-post-claims-responsibility-n1075721 (NBC News)]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Sinai Province|ISIL – Sinai Province]] pledges allegiance to the new caliph, [[Abu Ibrahim al-Hashimi al-Qurayshi]]. [https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/egypts-sinai-province-swears-allegiance-new-leader (Voice of America)]
*Illegal militant loggers in the [[Amazon rainforest]] shoot dead an indigenous activist named {{ill|Paulo Paulino Guajajara|de}} and wounds another. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-indigenous/illegal-loggers-kill-amazon-indigenous-warrior-who-guarded-forest-wound-another-idUSKBN1XC0GR (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[United Kingdom]] imposes an immediate [[Moratorium (law)|moratorium]] on [[hydraulic fracturing]], also known as "fracking", a technique for the recovery of oil or gas reserves. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-fracking/in-seismic-shift-britain-orders-immediate-moratorium-on-fracking-idUSKBN1XC001 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Protestors vandalize numerous businesses, such as [[HSBC Building (Hong Kong)|the headquarters]] of [[The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation|HSBC]] and the offices of [[Xinhua News Agency]], and set fire to the entrance of numerous [[MTR|metro stations]] after [[Hong Kong Police Force|police]] violently clashed with protestors earlier in the day. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-protesters-trash-xinhua-agency-office-in-night-of-violence-idUSKBN1XC03J?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Iraqi protests]]
**Thousands of protestors block the roads leading to [[Umm Qasr Port]] near [[Basra]], demanding the end to foreign influence in the country. The blockades were set up after security forces clashed with protestors earlier. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iraqi-protesters-block-major-port-basra-unrest-continues-191102104619357.html (Al Jazeera)] 

;Science and technology
*A [[Niagara Scow|shipwreck]] stuck at [[Niagara Falls]] moves for the first time in 101 years due to high winds and heavy rains. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/topstories/niagara-falls-boat-stuck-on-rocks-101-years-dislodged/ar-AAJKC6B?ocid=spartanntp (MSN)]

;Sports
*[[2019 Rugby World Cup]]
** [[South Africa national rugby union team|South Africa]] defeat [[England national rugby union team|England]] 32–12 to be crowned World Champions for the third time. [https://sports.nbcsports.com/2019/11/02/south-africa-beats-england-32-12-wins-3rd-world-cup-title/?fbclid=IwAR1CT-VlHJM7lINCqMEYXgRYs-HG0qVdiY-nqllLt4eWgVwS7myDy0Rotb4 (NBC Sports)]
